quotes: The Stone of Jordan
Rare Ring (10 FCR / +20 Str / +40 Life / Resistances) — Nagelrings if using Spirit Monarch
Crafted Caster Amulet with 12+% Faster Cast Rate (+2 Assassin Skills / 20 FCR / +20 All Res / 25 MF)
Phoenix Monarch (or Spirit Monarch, freeing a ring slot for Nagelring)

A Crafted Caster Amulet with 12+% Faster Cast Rate allows us to use The Stone of Jordan in one of our Ring slots. Use a Rare Ring if you don't have access to that Crafted Caster Amulet. It is important to reach the 102% Faster Cast Rate Breakpoint.

Flickering Flame is a massive boost to your damage. It also counteracts the negative effect of Flame Rift. Simply replace 3 Shimmering Small Charms of Good Luck for it to farm areas containing Immune to Fire monsters.
Phoenix Monarch is not absolutely necessary. A Spirit Monarch does the trick and allows for more customization in the Ring slots, Nagelrings become an option here.

An Act 2 Mercenary equipped with Infinity Thresher is essential for the success of this build. Andariel's Visage and Fortitude Sacred Armor make the Mercenary is virtually immortal and provide him with significant Physical Damage.

quotes: Andariel's Visage (ethereal; 15 IAS / 30 Fire Res jewel)
The Fire Blast Assassin achieves a fine balance between high mobility, damage and high Magic Find.

A Crafted Caster Amulet with 12+% Faster Cast Rate allows us to use The Stone of Jordan in one of our Ring slots. Use a Rare Ring if you don't have access to that Crafted Caster Amulet. It is important to reach the 102% Faster Cast Rate Breakpoint.

Flickering Flame is a massive boost to your damage. It also counteracts the negative effect of Flame Rift. Simply replace 3 Shimmering Small Charms of Good Luck for it to farm areas containing Immune to Fire monsters.
Phoenix Monarch is not absolutely necessary. A Spirit Monarch does the trick and allows for more customization in the Ring slots, Nagelrings become an option here.

An Act 2 Mercenary equipped with Infinity Thresher is essential for the success of this build. Andariel's Visage and Fortitude Sacred Armor make the Mercenary is virtually immortal and provide him with significant Physical Damage.
